findings.title: Path traversal in file download route
findings.description: req.params.name is joined to UPLOAD_DIR without normalising and checking that the result stays inside it, so '../' sequences (URL-decoded by Express) read arbitrary files readable by the process. Resolve the path and verify it starts with UPLOAD_DIR + path.sep, or use res.sendFile(name, { root: UPLOAD_DIR }).
findings.suggestion: Use res.sendFile(req.params.name, { root: UPLOAD_DIR }) or verify the resolved path is inside UPLOAD_DIR.
